exampleEn: We had a surprise quiz in class today.
exampleZh: 我們今天課堂上有個臨時測驗。

exampleEn: She loves listening to jazz on the weekend.
exampleZh: 她喜歡在週末聽爵士樂。

exampleEn: A gentle zephyr cooled the summer afternoon.
exampleZh: 一陣輕柔的微風使夏日午後涼爽起來。

exampleEn: Plants release oxygen during photosynthesis.
exampleZh: 植物在光合作用時釋放氧氣。

exampleEn: The drummer kept a steady rhythm all night.
exampleZh: 鼓手整晚都保持著穩定的節奏。

exampleEn: They put a coin in the jukebox and danced.
exampleZh: 他們在點唱機投了個硬幣然後跳起舞來。

exampleEn: The young wizard cast his first spell.
exampleZh: 年輕的巫師施展了他的第一個咒語。

exampleEn: I could hear the buzz of bees in the garden.
exampleZh: 我能聽見花園裡蜜蜂的嗡嗡聲。

exampleEn: The water spun into a powerful vortex.
exampleZh: 水流旋轉成一個強大的漩渦。

exampleEn: The watch is powered by a tiny quartz crystal.
exampleZh: 這支手錶由一塊微小的石英晶體驅動。

exampleEn: He zipped up his jacket against the cold.
exampleZh: 他拉上外套的拉鍊抵禦寒冷。

exampleEn: The knight rode bravely into the battle.
exampleZh: 騎士勇敢地騎馬投入戰鬥。

exampleEn: A syzygy occurs when three bodies align in space.
exampleZh: 當三個天體在空間中排成一線時就會發生朔望。

exampleEn: She finished the jigsaw puzzle in one evening.
exampleZh: 她在一個晚上拼完了那幅拼圖。

exampleEn: A red fox darted across the snowy field.
exampleZh: 一隻紅狐快速跑過雪白的田野。

exampleEn: The children love to jump on the trampoline.
exampleZh: 孩子們喜歡在彈簧床上跳躍。

exampleEn: The queen waved to the cheering crowd.
exampleZh: 女王向歡呼的群眾揮手。

exampleEn: Small delays always vex experienced travelers.
exampleZh: 小小的延誤總是惹惱有經驗的旅客。

exampleEn: The path zigzagged up the steep hillside.
exampleZh: 這條小徑沿著陡峭的山坡曲折而上。

exampleEn: We paddled the kayak across the calm lake.
exampleZh: 我們划著獨木舟橫越平靜的湖面。

exampleEn: The dog wore a soft muzzle on the walk.
exampleZh: 那隻狗散步時戴著柔軟的口套。

exampleEn: Shoppers rushed in during the sale frenzy.
exampleZh: 顧客在促銷狂潮中蜂擁而入。

exampleEn: Our main objective is to improve quality.
exampleZh: 我們的主要目標是提升品質。

exampleEn: The dress was made of exquisite silk.
exampleZh: 這件洋裝是用精緻的絲綢製成的。

exampleEn: He drank a strong cup of java each morning.
exampleZh: 他每天早上喝一杯濃咖啡。

exampleEn: The fishing boats were tied up at the quay.
exampleZh: 漁船都停泊在碼頭邊。

exampleEn: A thin haze covered the morning hills.
exampleZh: 一層薄霧籠罩著清晨的山丘。

exampleEn: The cabin felt warm and cozy in winter.
exampleZh: 那間小屋在冬天感覺溫暖又舒適。

exampleEn: A single jewel sparkled on the crown.
exampleZh: 王冠上一顆寶石閃閃發光。

exampleEn: The bridge has a maximum weight limit.
exampleZh: 這座橋有一個最大載重限制。

exampleEn: The sky turned a clear azure after the rain.
exampleZh: 雨後天空變成一片澄澈的蔚藍。

exampleEn: He strummed an old folk song on the banjo.
exampleZh: 他用班卓琴彈奏一首古老的民謠。

exampleEn: She wore a ring set with a golden topaz.
exampleZh: 她戴著一枚鑲有金色黃玉的戒指。

exampleEn: The zealous volunteers worked all night.
exampleZh: 那些熱忱的志工工作了一整夜。

exampleEn: A lynx prowled silently through the forest.
exampleZh: 一隻山貓無聲地在森林中潛行。

exampleEn: The friendly quokka posed for a photo.
exampleZh: 那隻友善的短尾矮袋鼠擺好姿勢拍照。

exampleEn: Artisans bejewel the crown with rare gems.
exampleZh: 工匠用稀有寶石裝飾這頂王冠。

exampleEn: They danced a slow waltz at the ball.
exampleZh: 他們在舞會上跳了一支緩慢的華爾滋。

exampleEn: Our jovial host greeted every guest warmly.
exampleZh: 我們愉快的主人熱情地歡迎每位客人。

exampleEn: Each sign of the zodiac has its own symbol.
exampleZh: 黃道十二宮的每個星座都有自己的符號。
